also_read: open full texts reached from these records (PMC, MDPI, institutional mirrors)
search.screening: All 270 records were read twice: once by the first sweep and once in four chunks by separate readers; every candidate from either pass was checked by two independent reviewers (source fidelity; criteria and arithmetic).

member_rule: single defined peptide; the IC50 is the peptide's own value against xanthine oxidase
xanthine substrate, uric-acid readout (absorbance 290-295 nm or HPLC); the readout is recorded, never an exclusion; many abstracts do not state it
one stated number (no range, inequality, single-concentration %, or figure reading)
uM/mM/mmol/L as read; mass units converted only for plain standard-residue linear peptides (ExPASy average residue masses + 18.015)
material recorded (synthetic/purified/unknown), not an exclusion; designed sequences allowed and flagged
the scored species' own peptides are never members
